address: via XX Settembre 27, Marciana Marina, 57033, Italy
bio: Located just a few metres from the enchanting seafront at Marciana, this restaurant is one of the island’s gastronomic gems, offering a menu that features interesting combinations of beautifully presented meat and especially fish dishes There’s also a private terrace for romantic dining in summer (book well in advance) and although wines are not available by the glass, choosing a top-quality half-bottle is always an option....
